quantum_view: 8 engineered features, standardised then rescaled to [0, pi] on the training draw
subsample: 3 class-balanced draws of up to 500 DS1 beats per class (seeds 0..2)
vqc: 4 one-vs-rest binary VQCs (angle encoding, 2 StronglyEntanglingLayers, class-weighted BCE, 30 epochs), scores normalised to sum to 1, argmax
qsvm: IQP fidelity kernel, class-weighted multi-class SVC, softmax of one-vs-rest decision values
deviation_from_plan: 1D-CNN replaced by an MLP on RR features + 24-sample waveform (no deep-learning library installed); class Q not scored

environment.quantum_device: default.qubit (noiseless statevector simulator, analytic expectation values)
